_comment: TEMPLATE — /iadc-advisor:setup asset. /iadc-advisor:setup writes the real .mcp.json (gitignored) into the app repo with LITERAL values, not ${VAR} — the Windows Desktop app does not reliably expand ${VAR} in .mcp.json. Every _comment key is a note to /iadc-advisor:setup and is dropped from the file it writes.

iadc._comment: The graph MCP is served by the standalone Graph service on port 8001, over cleartext http — a separate service from the review API on 8000, which does NOT serve /mcp. The api-key is the Graph service's own key, not the review service's. The scheme becomes https once the endpoint is TLS-terminated; until then http is correct and https fails the handshake.
